requirements.text: A large autonomous technology business is looking for an experienced engineer to join the team. The role focuses on developing software that enables complex decision-making and motion planning for robotic systems in real-world environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve sophisticated technical challenges in robotics and deep learning.
• Strong professional experience programming in C++ with a focus on writing efficient code
• Experience solving motion planning problems or related challenges in the robotics field
• Background in building or evaluating machine learning-based systems
• Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple technical teams
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a similar technical field
